digests: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; exact source bytes and lossless closed canonical selected values

selector.value_and_key: native action key or selected flow key

optional_operation_browser.selected_sha256: closed lossless selected source subset digest
optional_operation_browser.origins: sorted unique native canonical strings; default ports omitted
optional_operation_browser.confirmation_policy: exact optional native metadata; omission remains absent
optional_operation_browser.registration_input_slots: metadata only, complete native conditional schema

action_mapping.request_body: sole selected actions[key].parameters complete native schema
action_mapping.response_body: output name and complete native type/schema, including presence/count/extraction metadata

shape_table.preservation: reject duplicate/unsupported execution fields; no float roundtrip; preserve numeric lexemes, JSON Schema extensions, false, zero, empty strings and brace escapes
shape_table.selected_subtree: COMPLETE actions[key]/flows[key], all fields/empty/schema/extensions; full source hash binds shared contexts

supplement.digest_admission: ManifestInputArtifacts/InputDigest include supplement, referenced profiles and reviews; supplement has no package/input self digest
supplement.absent_browser: no supplement; every prior non-browser identity remains byte-identical

browser_config.host_fact_refs: opaque independently supplied trusted host witness references, not a self-reported trace
browser_config.verification_inputs: expected browser plan/attempt and trusted host witnesses supplied independently from submitted report/evidence
browser_config.driver_closure: full source/lock/binary and exact Node/Playwright/Chromium bytes/version/revision
browser_config.compatibility: existing runevidence versions, legacy BrowserConfig and report-v5 bytes remain unchanged
browser_config.single_durable_session: at most one binding/access lease, other fresh in-memory named sessions allowed; per-call reuse/save only matching bound named context; <=1candidate-producing auth permission
browser_config.construction_order: independently finalized human receipt without containing authority/config hash -> independent host facts without self hash -> COMPLETE Config -> canonical ConfigSHA256 -> Authority; acyclic

canonical_encoding: strict duplicate/Unicode validation; UseNumber; preserve numeric lexemes; UTF8-byte sorted keys, array order; Go Encoder SetEscapeHTML(false), standard controls plus escaped U+2028/U+2029; no indent/BOM/trailing newline; golden bytes/hash
